anthropic.method: Issuer-derived from Form S-1 (pp. 13, 144, 236): 846,840,960 post-split Class N shares contributed to Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, LLC represent 5% of fully diluted shares as of June 30, 2026 (assuming full conversion of the Amazon Notes). Pre-fund FD = 846,840,960 / 0.05 = 16,936,819,200 post-split (1,693,681,920 pre-split); including the fund = 17,783,660,160 post-split (1,778,366,016 pre-split). Internal basis is pre-split (splitFactor 10, S-1 p. 22) to match wrapper filed units. Low excludes the fund (or equals the '5% of post-issuance' reading of S-1 p. 13); high adds one future 2% public-benefit milestone issuance (S-1 p. 13).

default.explanation: June 30, 2026 fully diluted count including 846.8M post-split Class N shares contributed to Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, LLC (S-1 p. 13).

high.explanation: Adds one future 2% public-benefit milestone issuance triggered by a +50% share-price appreciation from the IPO price (S-1 p. 13).

sources.note: 846,840,960 post-split Class N shares contributed to Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, LLC (a wholly owned subsidiary), representing 5% of fully diluted shares as of June 30, 2026 assuming full conversion of the Amazon Notes (S-1 pp. 13, 144, 236). Shares are legally outstanding but excluded from GAAP share counts (S-1 pp. 20, 24).
sources.estimationMethod: Pre-fund FD = 846,840,960 / 0.05 = 16,936,819,200 post-split (1,693,681,920 pre-split, lowShares); including the fund = 16,936,819,200 + 846,840,960 = 17,783,660,160 post-split (1,778,366,016 pre-split, defaultShares). Divided by splitFactor 10 (S-1 p. 22).

sources.note: One future 2% public-benefit milestone issuance (~1,814.0M pre-split). The board may issue up to an additional 2% of then-outstanding fully diluted shares (including the fund's shares) each time the share price appreciates 50% above the prior milestone, starting from the IPO price (S-1 p. 13).
10-for-1 forward stock split of Class A and Class N common stock effective September 17, 2026, retroactive in GAAP common share data (S-1 p. 22). Preferred prices are quoted pre-split (S-1 p. F-47).

Preferred stock original issue prices per pre-split share (S-1 p. F-47): Series E-1 $56.09 ($61.5B, 1,096.4M implied FD), Series F-1 $140.97 ($183B, 1,298.2M implied FD), Series G-1 $259.14 ($380B, 1,466.4M implied FD), Series H-1 $589.0095 ($965B, 1,638.3M implied FD; $58.90 per post-split ANT share).

fullyDilutedTable.totalNote: Sum of the five column totals in the company's table (S-1/A No. 2 p. 24); the table does not print a grand total.

amazonNotes.note: Only part converts at the IPO because of Amazon's ownership cap; the remainder converts quarterly at the lowest of the fixed price, the IPO price and the 10-day VWAP, still capped (S-1/A No. 2 p. 172). The table counts the rollover at fixed conversion prices.

reserves.note: Not in the fully diluted count. 2026 Plan also includes the 2021 Plan remainder; the Donation Matching Plan reserve may increase by up to 1% a year through 2036.

publicBenefitIssuance.note: After the IPO the board may issue up to an additional 2% of then-outstanding fully diluted shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund each time the share price appreciates 50% above the prior milestone, starting from the IPO price.
